specialistReviews.resolution: Keep capability PARTIAL; require native authenticated server actor test and no direct public RPC privilege.

specialistReviews.finding: Unique active-owner index requires source demotion before target promotion in same transaction, protected by row lock.

challenge.scenario: Existing group owner attempts to transfer ownership to their own user ID.
challenge.finding: Self-transfer could create noisy duplicate audit or mask no-op owner state.
challenge.resolution: Canonical OWNER_TRANSFER_SELF_FORBIDDEN blocks it before row changes.

challenge.scenario: Another ordinary member tries to transfer ownership to themself.
challenge.finding: Actor could seize control of group and private messages.
challenge.resolution: Require private.office_active_thread_owner_v1 for original active owner plus read access.

challenge.scenario: Current owner chooses a user who left the group.
challenge.finding: Inactive user could become privileged chat owner with no read access.
challenge.resolution: SELECT active participant with left_at IS NULL and participant_role member plus thread readability.

challenge.scenario: Current owner chooses a user from another tenant.
challenge.finding: Cross-tenant owner assignment may reveal private workspace data.
challenge.resolution: Require participant lookup by instance_id and thread_id and target_user_id.

challenge.scenario: Two owners are created while changing roles.
challenge.finding: Unique active owner index raises error or corrupts owner state.
challenge.resolution: Demote current owner first then promote member, both updates in same transaction.

challenge.scenario: Target member leaves between lookup and promotion.
challenge.finding: No target remains and ownerless state may commit.
challenge.resolution: Lock target FOR UPDATE and check exactly one affected source/target row.

challenge.scenario: A concurrent transaction aborts after old owner is demoted.
challenge.finding: Partial transfer could leave group without owner.
challenge.resolution: Use atomic function transaction and raise exception on all missing evidence to roll back both steps.

challenge.scenario: Transfer is performed with forged p_actor under service_role.
challenge.finding: Definer SQL does not itself authenticate requesting user; impersonation remains possible.
challenge.resolution: Require native server identity binding/proof; mark current SQL+local PG as partial until verified.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Canonical Team Chat 2 foundation/integrity through 0066 supports at most one active owner via unique partial index but lacks an authorized, auditable transaction to transfer owner without exposing an unauthorized owner-seize route. Append exact canonical 20260909204547 owner transfer v1 as 0067: only current active owner in internal_private/group with read access can transfer to another active member with read access. Acquire FOR UPDATE row locks, demote source then promote target atomically preserving unique owner index, require row_count 1 both and final evidence; create audit and service_role-only EXECUTE. Rehearse 69 clean files on disposable socket-only PG18, no hosted DB updates. Native server actor binding remains partial.

Concurrency protects thread/target with FOR UPDATE and performs source demotion before target promotion, checks exact row_count and target final owner.
